children: Medibank Private may still be losing share of Australia's private-health insurance market, Citi says. "This view would also seem to be consistent with its comments that competitive conditions remain in line with 4Q26 with ongoing elevated switching and aggregator activity," analyst Nigel Pittaway says. Medibank made those comments when presenting to shareholders attending its annual meeting today. Citi notes Medibank had previously seemed to indicate conditions were improving. Now, Medibank points to examples where competitor intensity remains at the levels it saw in 4Q. "Taken at face value, this suggests it is now growing policyholders in the same competitive conditions as it was losing them in 4Q, with momentum leading into the end of the calendar year," Citi says. Medibank is down 1.0% at A$5.305. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
